newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Subscriptions open to Antonov Dutch offering.
newsitem.headline: Subscriptions open to Antonov Dutch offering.

text.p: Subscriptions to the Dutch bourse launch of British gearbox maker Antonov Plc on Amsterdam's New Market (NMAX) have opened and will run until Thursday April 24, broker Leemhuis & Van Loon said on Monday.
The offering has been fixed at a maximum of 2.63 million ordinary shares, Leemhuis & Van Loon said.
Antonov has been listed on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) since August 1995. The subscription price will be determined by the closing price of the stock on AIM on Thursday.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances, the first day of trading has been set for April 25," Leemhuis & Van Loon said.

Earlier this month, Antonov expanded its share capital by five percent through placements of new shares with mainly Dutch institutional investors. These raised about three million sterling, the company said.
On April 11, Antonov posted a 1996 pre-tax loss of 1.76 million stg, narrowing year-earlier losses of 1.79 million stg. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
